name: LRG 3-757 (Hubble)
blurb: LRG 3-757, a massive galaxy bending a more distant galaxy into an Einstein ring, seen by Hubble.
label: lrg3757-hubble
story: The gravity of a massive galaxy magnifies and warps the light of a far more distant galaxy into a nearly complete ring. The alignment is so exact that the system is nicknamed the Cosmic Horseshoe.

claims.text: LRG 3-757 is one of the Luminous Red Galaxies, with an unusually large mass
A background galaxy is magnified and warped into a nearly complete ring
The lensed galaxy forms an Einstein ring requiring exact alignment
The system's nickname is the Cosmic Horseshoe
Program 11602 targets LRG-3-757, a strongly lensed star-forming galaxy
